name_reason: Follows fd2_<domain>_<descriptor> convention (domain=chapter, descriptor=10_end). The '10' is a meaningful chapter ID (valid range 1-30 per assets/chapters), not an address residue; function address is 0x235f9 and bears no relation to the literal 10. Name accurately reflects the chapter-10 end handler role confirmed by the 0x51DE9 dispatch-table xref and the walkthrough (洞窟中的激戰).
purpose: Chapter 10「洞窟中的激戰」end-of-battle handler: plays the post-rescue cutscene, repositions and revives the party and the rescued NPCs (索菲亞/卡納恩三世), shows the closing dialog, recruits 索菲亞 (char 11) and resets 萊汀 (char 6), then advances the chapter id.
logic_summary: 1) Copies the two 11-byte scene position tables (X @0x52113, Y @0x5211E) onto the stack. 2) Fades palette to black and clears every char's acted flag. 3) Loops i=0..10 placing party units 0..0xA at the table tiles with sprite_state[1] (facing)=2. 4) Repositions/revives the rescued NPCs: char 0x32(索菲亞)->(15,35) sleep flag cleared, char 0x33(卡納恩三世)->(14,35) sleep flag cleared, char 0x34->(16,35) flags cleared, char 5 flags cleared. 5) Resets battle_anim_phase; sets view-window origin and cursor-world to (9,34) and cursor-screen to (0,0). 6) Composites one battle frame, fades palette in, delays 200ms. 7) Shows dialog page 4, resets battle_anim_phase, fires cutscene event 0x25, shows dialog page 5. 8) Saves runtime chars to template, recruits char 11(索菲亞) and re-inits char 6(萊汀) from base/growth (resets his stats/items per the walkthrough), then increments current_chapter_id.

returns.semantics: No return value. Side effects only: mutates the runtime_char array, battle view/cursor/anim globals, the template store, and current_chapter_id.

Walkthrough note '萊汀 attributes/items reset after this chapter' matches fd2_init_runtime_char_from_base_growth(6). runtime_char struct fields (pos_x +0x00, sprite_state[1]=facing, flags +0x05 bit0=dead, status_sleep_flag +0x26) confirmed from src/include/types.h. All globals confirmed declared in src/include/globals.h. Positions in plate use decimal (15,35),(14,35),(16,35),(9,34) = hex 0xf/0xe/0x10 x, 0x23/0x22 y -- consistent with decompile.
